title: Sample-based quantum diagonalization approach for open-shell transition-metal complexes in gas and implicit-solvent
summary: Open-shell $3d$ transition-metal complexes pose a stringent challenge for correlated electronic-structure methods because near-degenerate metal $d$ orbitals give rise to competing spin states and oxidation-state-dependent charge transfer, while solvation can reshape the relative stability of the resulting electronic configurations. Building on prior demonstrations of open-shell sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) for light-atom systems and, separately, closed-shell SQD coupled to the integral-equation-formalism polarizable continuum model (IEF-PCM), we combine these capabilities…
